messages:
Noah: hi all, day 1! quick question: I need temporary staging admin to flip a flag for a live demo later today. Who do I ask and what's the fastest path?
Aria: welcome Noah! fastest is a time-bound temp admin via Console access requests. Fill the request form and tag @infra + @people-ops. include demo window and rollback steps.
Noah: I clicked Request access but the org-level option is disabled for me. Is that because my Okta groups haven't synced?
infra: usually new accounts need the 'admin:request' claim. people-ops adds it after onboarding. If it's urgent, open an infra ticket with demo time and reason and we can issue a 2-hour temp session.
Noah: perfect. what info should I put in the ticket?
Aria: ticket body: demo id, flag names, exact start/end times, monitoring checklist, approved approver (must be 2FA-enabled). also include rollback criteria e.g., "revert if latency > 100ms or error-rate > 0.3% within 10m".
people-ops: we'll verify your manager sign-off before granting the claim. if it's vendor-facing, add stakeholder emails.
Noah: thanks. filing the infra ticket now and CCing my manager.
access-bot: Access request INF-509 created by Noah. Status: pending infra review :hourglass:
infra: received INF-509. if you attach the demo runbook we'll try to approve before the demo. temp session tokens are delivered via the secure vault.
Noah: added runbook and pinged manager. appreciate the quick help! :pray:
